clusters.title: France: Founder of small centre-left party wins presidential primary
clusters.neutral_headline: France: Founder of small centre-left party wins presidential primary
bullet_summary: He is Raphaël Glucksmann, a member of the European Parliament and founder of the “Place Publique” party
Reported by France24, Guardian World

items.title: France: Founder of small centre-left party wins presidential primary
items.standfirst: In France, a primary organised by the opposition Socialists and their centre-left allies held this Sunday has resulted in a clear winner. He is Raphaël Glucksmann, a member of the European Parliament and founder of the “Place Publique” party. He emerges now, at age 46, as a major figure in the election campaign for the French Presidency. That election will be held in April. Story by Nicholas Rushworth.
items.content: In France, a primary organised by the opposition Socialists and their centre-left allies held this Sunday has resulted in a clear winner. items.title: French centre left must wage ‘existential battle’ to prevent far right winning presidency
items.standfirst: French MEP Raphaël Glucksmann issues call after becoming the social democrat candidate for 2027 presidential run The European lawmaker Raphaël Glucksmann has urged the French centre left to wage an “existential battle” to prevent Marine Le Pen’s far right winning the 2027 presidential election, after he was chosen as the social democrat candidate for the presidency.“We’ve got to rid our hearts of the spirit of defeat,” Glucksmann, founder of the small party Place Publique, said on Monday morning after his decisive win in a centre-left primary race held by the Socialist party. items.title: Raphaël Glucksmann, the man who wants to be French president
items.standfirst: Raphaël Glucksmann has won the primary to represent the French centre-left in the upcoming presidential elections, securing 66% of the vote. He now faces the challenge of building support for the centre-left in a political landscape where the far right, led by Marine Le Pen, remains a major force.
